newsitem.title: USA: Holly Holdings unit awarded Lucent contract.
newsitem.headline: Holly Holdings unit awarded Lucent contract.

text.p: Holly Holdings Inc said Friday that Lucent Technologies Inc has awarded an initial trial order to Navatech Industries Inc, a subsidiary of Holly Holdings, for Navatech's fabrication of fiberoptic interface circuit boards.
The company did not disclose the terms of the transaction.

Holly Holdings, headquartered in Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania, has three subsidiaries: Navatech which manufactures and tests electronic components; Nightlife Printing and Promotions Inc which is engaged in a "print on demand" commercial offset printing business; and American Publishers Co Inc which markets educational products to schools and libraries.
